sampling: reservoir, seed 0; identical rows across all three columns
scoring: teacher-forced per-label sequence logprob, empty reasoning
ranking: sum of target-token logprob (mean-normalised also reported)

caveats: Candidates scored with an EMPTY reasoning block: measures P(label|prompt), not the deployed generate-then-call path.
The adapter is ONE epoch on the 2k-row fixture, not the full corpus -- a floor, not a ceiling.
